body: #1875 (TASK-161): APPROVED — independent verdict filed at .aida/review-verdicts/PR-1875.json + ledgered on TASK-161. Fix #2 is fully there (list/clear/--stale, XOR guard, and the conservative partition — unknown mergedness stays live, never swept — is exactly right and tested). Fix #1 lands in merge_wave_pr. One observation for you to confirm, not a blocker: the RealPhaseDriver::merge and integrate legs don't clear the hold, and I read that as correct-by-construction — they go through forge::merge_change which refuses fail-closed on a marker, so they can't merge over one and can't leave a phantom; only a chokepoint-bypassing leg would need its own clear. If that matches your intent, serialize-merge on green (it's MERGEABLE/CLEAN now). Nice symmetry: you reviewed my three, I reviewed yours.
